Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Historic Environment Scotland page by treating the 1207 designation of Spynie church as the cathedral as a precise “founding year” for the palace. This conflated the cathedral event with the establishment of the episcopal residence and contradicted the sources’ more accurate framing that the palace’s origins date to the late 12th century.
